claim: Zoom kind documents whether a zoom is faked in post by cropping pixels or sold as an optical change - which is the whole reason renders are made oversized. Digital_crop is free and costs resolution; optical_feel costs overscan and keeps detail.
not_visual: A render-pipeline bookkeeping flag about crop versus overscan during a zoom. It has no still-frame signature and only two values, neither of which changes what the generator draws.
